findings.title: except Exception silently swallows gateway failures
findings.body: According to custom instructions in 'Error Handling Standards' (no except Exception that swallows an error without logging or re-raising): `execute` returns `None` on any gateway failure. Log the failure and re-raise.

summary.problem: The `except Exception:` in `ChargeAccount.execute` swallows every gateway failure into a silent `None`.
summary.done_well: The repository keeps the flush-only convention of the module. Both paths of `execute` are tested.
